issue: "«paraphysis» se usa para estructuras distintas" is stated as fact, but only Tsuneki (R246.2: "so-called paraphysis of the lungfish is not a paraphysis, but a dorsal sac") shows a different referent; for Khonsari (R455.1, excerpt-only) the excerpt "does not address the telencephalic structure", so that Khonsari's left epithalamic diverticulum is a different structure from the others is an inference of the review (the body of S4 itself says so), not a statement of the source.
fix: «paraphysis» parece designar estructuras distintas: Tsuneki juzga que la llamada paráfisis del pez pulmonado es un saco dorsal [@R246.2], y Khonsari llama «paraphysis (or parietal)» al divertículo epitalámico izquierdo [@R455.1], aunque el extracto no aborda la estructura telencefálica (la diferencia es inferencia de esta revisión).
